chain_continuity_all_days.declared_outage: crossed only through an authenticated signed outage document whose whole range lies inside one pack: every token of the range UNREVEALED and no other UNREVEALED row; the token before the range OPENED (in the previous verified pack when the range starts the day) with the document previous_public_chain_sha256 as the chain head; the first token after the range OPENED in the same pack; every later link recomputed; the document anchored no later than the pack (equal times accepted). Cross-day ranges are not supported and keep integrity HOLD. Those tokens remain public misses.
chain_continuity_all_days.late_pack: a late pack is fully verified and its final chain continues the cross-pack seam; its own penalty is unchanged
chain_continuity_all_days.unavailable_predecessor: a missing, invalid or unbridgeable predecessor never penalizes a later verified day; that seam is reported UNVERIFIED and cryptographic integrity is HOLD until it can be verified

evidence_classes.EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: a referenced public file is missing or unreadable, or a verification tool cannot run, gives an indeterminate result or fails without positively attributing the failure to the evidence: no penalty, integrity HOLD until resolved
evidence_classes.INVALID_PACK: demonstrated invalid signature, bytes or content (every input readable and the failure positively attributed to the evidence by the verification tool or by a hash or chain mismatch): one public miss per expected official token
evidence_classes.precedence: INVALID_PACK > EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE > LATE_PENDING / LATE_FINAL_PENALTY / ON_TIME / LATE_RESTORED

full_pack_timing.INVALID_PACK: as V4.1: one public miss per expected official token
full_pack_timing.LATE_FINAL_PENALTY: Sigstore time > deadline + 86400, or no admitted verified pack at deadline + 86400 (including a manifest still without a bundle): every expected official token of the day is a public miss, frozen; a later opening may restore audit content, never the score
full_pack_timing.LATE_PENDING: no verified pack while evaluation time < deadline + 86400; not final; excluded from final figures and listed
full_pack_timing.LATE_RESTORED: deadline < Sigstore time <= deadline + 86400 and the pack fully verifies; scored by content; public LATE flag with the exact lateness in seconds
full_pack_timing.ON_TIME: Sigstore time <= deadline; scored by content
full_pack_timing.admission: Evidence counts only if its verified Sigstore time is not after the evaluation instant. A pack manifest without its Sigstore bundle is not yet published: LATE_PENDING inside the window, LATE_FINAL_PENALTY after it.
full_pack_timing.boundaries: Sigstore time equal to the deadline is ON_TIME; equal to deadline + 86400 is LATE_RESTORED; a day is never penalized twice
full_pack_timing.deadline: unchanged: UTC day end + 345600 s + 600 s; evidence = earliest verified Sigstore transparency time of the pack manifest

prior_days: Scoring of every earlier day stays under V4/V4.1, including every frozen penalty.
reason: Unopened = miss keeps withholding pointless. Opened late = miss forever adds no protection once the opening matches the earlier commitments, so from 2026-10-21 a short delay is flagged instead of erasing the day. Past penalties stay as signed.
